canonical_project: GO Telecom Syria data centers framework
owner: Etihad Atheeb Telecommunications Co. (GO Telecom) / Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
notes: Listed-company announcement says the five-year framework includes establishment of two data centers, cloud/backup environment, technology platform and cybersecurity center with possible value of SAR 1.955 billion. Specific data-center sites were not disclosed; Damascus assignment is provisional because the ministry counterparty and signing forum were in Damascus.
